deviations.what: docker/publish.sh takes the local image names from RUNTIME_IMAGE and DEVELOPMENT_IMAGE (and the docker command from DOCKER), and asks about both tags before pushing either.
deviations.why: Keeps the plan's argument list (VERSION [REPOSITORY]) and makes a registry error on the second tag stop the script before the first is pushed.

deviations.what: image.yml builds the demo portal with `docker buildx build --builder default` instead of build-push-action.
deviations.why: The portal builds FROM images that exist only in the engine's store; a container builder cannot see them (probed locally: pull access denied).

deviations.what: Added tests/test_docker/test_publish.py, a path the brief's scope list does not name.
deviations.why: publish.sh's skip-and-never-move and push-nothing-on-error behaviour is a contract; the directory is declared in non-mirror-paths.

concerns: Nothing in the two workflows has run on a GitHub runner. First-run assumptions: a Buildx builder named `default` exists beside the one setup-buildx-action creates; `--network host` reaches the PostGIS and Redis service containers on the runner's localhost; coverage.xml written as root inside the container is readable by the Codecov step.

The full suite was not run inside the development image here (only tests/test_smoke.py and tests/test_docker, 21 passed); the first CI run is the first full run there. `uv pip install` needed `--python /opt/venv/bin/python` because UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT does not reach the pip interface.

Publishing needs write access for this repository on the ghcr.io/fair-dm/fairdm package (plan P9) and a release created with RELEASE_TOKEN; neither can be shown before the first release (SC-003, AS 4.1).

The test-suite and image workflows share the gha cache scope `development`; both build with VERSION=dev on pull requests, so they share layers there, and a release build misses the cache once per release.

Locally the bind mount for docker.exe needs `wslpath -w $PWD`; the workflow uses plain $PWD on Linux. A dangling anonymous docker volume created at 17:01Z predates this session and was left alone. The images fairdm-demo:verify, fairdm-demo:local, fairdm-base:local, fairdm-base:local-dev and fairdm-base:verify* were already present and were left alone.

check-jsonschema covers the workflow schema and actionlint 1.7.12 (via actionlint-py, since `uvx actionlint` is not on PyPI) found nothing; shellcheck is not installed, so actionlint did not lint the run scripts with it.
